subdomains.title: Cybersecurity Policies and Procedures
subdomains.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity requirements are documented, communicated and complied with by the organization as per related laws and regulations, and organizational requirements.

controls.desc: Referring to control 1-3-1 in the ECC, cybersecurity policies and procedures must include the following:
Defining and documenting the cybersecurity requirements for the organization’s social media accounts as part of the organization’s cybersecurity policies.
controls.evidence:
• Document containing cybersecurity requirements for social media accounts requirements approved by the authorizing official.
• Ensuring compliance with the document in addition to disseminating it to employees and relevant parties.

subdomains.title: Cybersecurity Risk Management
subdomains.objective: To ensure managing cybersecurity risks in a methodological approach in order to protect the organization’s information and technology assets as per organizational policies and procedures, and related laws and regulations.

controls.desc: In addition to the controls within subdomain 1-5 in the ECC, requirements for cybersecurity risk management should include at least the following:
Assessing cybersecurity risks for the organization’s social media accounts at least once per year.
controls.evidence: • Risk Assessment report of all the organization’s social media accounts as per the cybersecurity requirements of the organization, and review it periodically based on the specified date.

controls.desc: Assessing cybersecurity risks during planning and before permitting use of the organization’s social media accounts.
controls.evidence: • Risk Assessment report of all the organization’s social media accounts as per the cybersecurity requirements, prior of initial use of the accounts.

controls.desc: Including cybersecurity risks related to the organization’s social media accounts in the organization’s cybersecurity risk register and monitoring them at least once per year.
controls.evidence:
• Inclusion of social media accounts’ risks in the cybersecurity risk register.
• Review report of cybersecurity risks associated with the requirements for the organization’s social media accounts.

subdomains.title: Cybersecurity in Human Resources
subdomains.objective: To ensure that cybersecurity risks and requirements related to personnel, including employees and contractors, are managed efficiently prior to employment, during employment and after termination or separation as per organizational policies and procedures, and related laws and regulations.

controls.desc: In addition to the subcontrols within control 1-9-4 in the ECC, cybersecurity requirements for personnel responsible for managing the organization’s social media accounts should include at least the following:
Cybersecurity awareness about social media accounts.
controls.evidence:
• Documented and approved customized awareness program for organization’s social media.
• Records of periodically conducted awareness sessions/training.

controls.desc: Implementation of and compliance with cybersecurity requirements as per the organizational cybersecurity policies and procedures for the organization’s social media accounts.
controls.evidence:
• Compliance report of cybersecurity requirements for the organization’s social media accounts.
• Sample of implementation of cybersecurity requirements for the social media accounts.
• Sample of Acceptable Use Policy forms signed by the organization’s personnel.

subdomains.title: Cybersecurity Awareness and Training Program
subdomains.objective: To ensure that personnel are aware of their cybersecurity responsibilities and have the essential cybersecurity awareness, and are provided with the required cybersecurity training, skills and credentials needed to accomplish their cybersecurity responsibilities and protect the organization’s information and technology assets.

controls.desc: In addition to the subcontrols within control 1-10-3 in the ECC, the cybersecurity awareness program must cover awareness about potential cyber risks and threats related to the organization’s social media accounts and their secure use to minimize these risks and threats, including the following:
Secure use and protection of devices dedicated to the organization’s social media accounts, and ensuring that they do not contain classified data or are not used for personal purposes.
controls.evidence:
• Documented and approved customized awareness program for social media which includes secure use and protection of social media devices.
• Sample of the awareness materials/contents provided to the organization’s personnel.

controls.desc: Secure handling of identities, passwords and security questions.
controls.evidence:
• Documented and approved customized awareness program for social media which includes secure handling of identity and access of social media accounts.
• Sample of the awareness materials/contents provided to the organization’s personnel.

controls.desc: The organization’s social media accounts restoration plan and dealing with cybersecurity incidents.
controls.evidence:
• Documented and approved customized awareness program for social media which includes social media account incident management and restoration plan.
• Sample of the awareness materials/contents provided to the organization’s personnel.
• Documented plan to recover the organization’s social media accounts.

controls.desc: Secure handling of applications and solutions used for the organization’s social media accounts.
controls.evidence:
• Documented and approved customized awareness program for social media which includes secure handling of social media applications and solutions.
• Sample of the awareness materials/contents provided to the organization’s personnel.

controls.desc: Not using the organization’s social media accounts for personal purposes, such as browsing.
controls.evidence:
• Documented and approved customized awareness program for social media which includes prohibition of usage of organization’s social media account for personal usage.
• Sample of the awareness materials/contents provided to the organization’s personnel.

controls.desc: Avoiding access to the organization’s social media accounts using untrusted public devices or networks.
controls.evidence:
• Documented and approved customized awareness program for social media which includes prohibition of accessing organization’s social media accounts using untrusted public devices or networks.
• Sample of the awareness materials/contents provided to the organization’s personnel.

controls.desc: Communicating directly with the cybersecurity department if a cybersecurity threat is suspected.
controls.evidence:
• Documented and approved customized awareness program for social media which includes communicating directly with cybersecurity department for suspected cybersecurity threat to social media accounts.
• Sample of the awareness materials/contents provided to the organization’s personnel.

controls.desc: In addition to the subcontrols within control 1-10-4 in the ECC, personnel responsible for managing the organization’s social media accounts must be trained in the required technical skills, plans and procedures necessary to ensure implementation of cybersecurity requirements and practices when using the organization’s social media accounts.
controls.evidence:
• Documented and approved customized training program for authorized personnel who are responsible for managing the organization’s social media accounts.
• Sample records of training conducted for or attended by personnel responsible for managing the social media accounts.

subdomains.title: Asset Management
subdomains.objective: To ensure that the organization has an accurate and detailed inventory of information and technology assets in order to support the organization’s cybersecurity and operational requirements and maintain the confidentiality, integrity and availability of information and technology assets.

controls.desc: In addition to the controls within subdomain 2-1 in the ECC, cybersecurity requirements for managing information and technology assets must include at least the following:
Identifying and inventorying the organization’s social media accounts and the information and technology assets related to them, and updating the inventory at least once every year.
controls.evidence:
• Documented and approved inventory of all the social media accounts with related assets.
• Periodic review report of inventory of social media assets of the organization.

subdomains.title: Identity and Access Management
subdomains.objective: To ensure secure and restricted logical access to information and technology assets in order to prevent unauthorized access and allow only authorized access for users that is necessary to accomplish assigned tasks.

controls.desc: In addition to the subcontrols within control 2-2-3 in the ECC, cybersecurity requirements for identity and access management related to the organization’s social media accounts must include at least the following:
Using social media accounts designated for organizations, not individuals.
controls.evidence: • Sample of social media accounts used in the organization to verify that it is designated only for organizations and not individuals.  And it should be noted that individuals referred to within the organization may either be responsible for managing the organizations social media accounts or may be regular users for these accounts, such as employees, clients, and affiliates of the organization. In both cases, they are required to adhere to the organization’s policy, regarding the use of social media accounts.

controls.desc: Registering using official information, including an official social media email and official mobile number, and not using personal information.
controls.evidence: • Sample of the official information used for registration of social media account.

controls.desc: Verifying the organization’s social media accounts whenever possible and maintaining a consistent identity across the organization’s social media networks to facilitate recognition of official accounts and discovery of fraud or unofficial accounts.
controls.evidence: • Sample of organization’s social media accounts that have been verified/authorized by the social media platform.

controls.desc: Using a secure and specific password for each organization’s social media account, changing the password regularly and not reusing passwords.
controls.evidence:
• Documented social media accounts controls specifying that cybersecurity requirements for password management of social media accounts.
• Periodic reports that details changes in the passwords of social media accounts.

controls.desc: Using multi-factor authentication for the organization’s social media account logins.
controls.evidence: • Sample of using multi-factor authentication while logging in to the social media accounts.

controls.desc: Activating and updating security questions and documenting them securely, where applicable.
controls.evidence:
• Documented social media accounts controls requiring the setup and update of security questions for the organizations’ social media accounts.
• Documented security questions in a secured and restricted file with access only to authorized personnel.

controls.desc: Managing access rights to the organization’s social media accounts based on business need, considering account sensitivity, access level and the type of devices and systems used.
controls.evidence:
• Documented social media accounts controls restricting the access rights of social media accounts based on the business needs within the organization considering the sensitivity of the accounts, the level of access rights, and the type of devices and systems used.
• Documented procedure of granting access to social media accounts (provisioning workflow).
• Sample of approved and implemented access right requests.

controls.desc: Restricting the access rights of service providers used for social media management, social media monitoring or brand protection.
controls.evidence:
• Documented social media controls restricting the access rights of social media accounts to the service providers.
• Sample of access rights granted to service providers.

controls.desc: Restricting access to the organization’s social media accounts to specific devices.
controls.evidence:
• Documented social media accounts controls restricting the access rights of social media accounts to specific devices.
• Sample of social media accounts configurations to restrict the access from specific device.
• Sample of social media account management platforms and services configurations that allow specifying the devices permitted to access the organization’s social media accounts.

controls.desc: With reference to ECC subcontrol 2-2-3-5, the user identities and access rights used for the organization’s social media accounts must be reviewed at least once every year.
controls.evidence: • Review report of user identities and access rights of organization’s social media accounts.

subdomains.title: Information System and Processing Facilities Protection
subdomains.objective: To ensure the protection of information systems and information processing facilities, including workstations and infrastructures, against cyber risks.

controls.desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-3-3, cybersecurity requirements for protecting the organization’s social media accounts and related technology assets must include at least the following:
Applying updates and security patches for social media applications at least once every month.
controls.evidence:
• Documented procedures for security patches and updates for social media applications.
• Periodic report for security patches and updates implemented on social media accounts applications.

controls.desc: Reviewing the configurations and hardening of the organization’s social media accounts and technology assets at least once every year.
controls.evidence:
• Documented security hardening procedures for applications handling social media accounts.
• Secure configurations and hardening review report that have been conducted periodically.

controls.desc: Reviewing and hardening default configurations, such as default passwords, pre-login, lockout, for the organization’s social media accounts and technology assets related to them.
controls.evidence:
• Documented policies and procedures for hardening default settings.
• Sample of default configurations for social media accounts.
• Default configuration review report for social media accounts.

controls.desc: Restricting activation of features and services in social media accounts on a need basis and carrying out a risk assessment when there is a need to activate them.
controls.evidence: • Documented risk assessment of social media accounts and their features before activation.

subdomains.title: Mobile Device Security
subdomains.objective: To ensure the protection of mobile devices, including laptops, smartphones and tablets, from cyber risks and to ensure secure handling of the organization’s information, including sensitive information, while utilizing Bring Your Own Device policy.

controls.desc: In addition to the subcontrols within control 2-6-3 in the ECC, cybersecurity requirements for mobile devices related to the organization’s social media accounts must include at least the following:
Centrally managing mobile devices used for the organization’s social media accounts using a Mobile Device Management system.
controls.evidence:
• Documented list of all the mobile devices in the organization used for handling organization’s social media accounts.
• Sample of Mobile Device Management (MDM) system’s configurations.

controls.desc: Applying updates and security patches on mobile devices at least once every month.
controls.evidence:
• Documented security patching procedures for social media applications.
• Patching review report for periodic security patching.

subdomains.title: Data and Information Protection
subdomains.objective: To ensure the confidentiality, integrity and availability of the organization’s data and information as per organizational policies and procedures, and related laws and regulations.

controls.desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-7-3, cybersecurity requirements for protecting and handling data and information for the organization’s social media accounts must include at least the following:
Technology assets used to manage the organization’s social media accounts must not contain classified data, in accordance with relevant regulations.
controls.evidence: • Review report of data classification contained in the assets used for handling organization’s social media accounts.

subdomains.title: Cybersecurity Events Logs and Monitoring Management
subdomains.objective: To ensure timely collection, analysis and monitoring of cybersecurity events for early detection of potential cyberattacks in order to prevent or minimize negative impacts on the organization’s operations.

controls.desc: In addition to the subcontrols in ECC control 2-12-3, cybersecurity requirements for event logs and monitoring management for the organization’s social media accounts and technology assets related to them must include at least the following:
Activating all notifications and cybersecurity alerts for the organization’s social media accounts and cybersecurity event logs on related technology assets.
controls.evidence: • Sample of cybersecurity notifications and alerts activated for events on the assets used for handling organization’s social media accounts.

controls.desc: Following the organization’s social media accounts and monitoring them to ensure that they do not post unauthorized content or receive unauthorized login attempts.
controls.evidence:
• Documented procedures for monitoring social media accounts.
• Review content that is posted on the organization’s social media accounts.

controls.desc: Monitoring social media networks to ensure the organization is not being impersonated.
controls.evidence:
• Review of social media network for impersonation of organization’s social media plan.
• Sample of the service used for brand protection.
• Documented procedure for handling identity impersonation of the organization, including specifying the necessary actions to be taken.
• Plan for reporting in case of social media account impersonation.
• Define and document non-discloure clauses for the organization’s social media accounts.

controls.desc: Automated monitoring for changes in account patterns, indicators of compromise, publication of unauthorized content or impersonation of the organization.
controls.evidence: • Automated monitoring of organizations’ social media accounts for any anomaly in behaviour.

subdomains.title: Cybersecurity Incident and Threat Management
subdomains.objective: To ensure timely identification, detection, effective management and handling of cybersecurity incidents and threats to prevent or minimize negative impacts on the organization’s operations.

controls.desc: In addition to the subcontrols within control 2-13-3 in the ECC, cybersecurity requirements for incident and threat management for the organization’s social media accounts must include at least the following:
Developing a plan to recover the organization’s social media accounts and deal with cybersecurity incidents.
controls.evidence: • Documented recovery plan for organization’s social media accounts.

subdomains.title: Third-Party Cybersecurity
subdomains.objective: To ensure the protection of assets against cybersecurity risks related to third parties, including outsourcing and managed services, as per organizational policies and procedures, and related laws and regulations.

controls.desc: A need assessment for the use of social media management, automated monitoring or brand-protection services, along with associated cybersecurity risks, must be conducted.
controls.evidence:
• Documented report to assess the needs of the organization before resorting to external parties’ services for managing social media accounts, automated monitoring, or brand protection services.
• Documented report for the risk assessment that conducted before resorting to external parties’ services for managing social media, automated monitoring or brand protection services.
• Documented report to assess the needs of the organization using social media management, automated monitoring or brand protection services.

controls.desc: In addition to ECC subcontrol 4-1-3, cybersecurity requirements for social media management, automated monitoring or brand-protection services in the organization must include at least the following:
Non-disclosure clauses and secure removal of the organization’s data by the third party upon service termination.
controls.evidence: • Documented service level agreement with third-parties who are responsible of managing social media accounts, automated monitoring or brand protection services firm that includes clauses of non-disclosure and secure data removal upon service termination.

controls.desc: Communication procedures for reporting vulnerabilities and cybersecurity incidents.
controls.evidence: • Documented procedures for cyber incidents and reporting of vulnerability to the organization, in the contract or service level agreement.

controls.desc: Requirements for the third party to comply with cybersecurity requirements and policies to protect the organization’s social media accounts, and related laws and regulations.
controls.evidence: • Documented procedures for compliance with the cybersecurity requirements and policies of the organization, and the relevant national legal and regulatory requirements in the service level agreement.
